thread:
Priya Sharma: quick Q from today's all-hands 1: leadership asked for a short public roadmap note. can we lock owner names + rough windows for API upgrades, Console UX cleanup, and Optimize cost features? want to avoid vague dates in the webinar.

Ben Ortiz: agree. we should mark them as targets but be specific enough for customers to plan. happy to hold final wording until canaries start.

Marco Valdez: ok here. high level draft windows i propose (tied to infra work):
- API runtime v2 canary: target 2024-05-20
- Console UX beta (org flags): target 2024-06-11
- Optimize cost-suggestions alpha (pilot): target 2024-07-05
These assume quant infra and canary traffic profiles are ready.

Sofia Rivas: for Optimize, scope of alpha = suggestion engine + dashboard heatmap. no autoscaling or billing integration yet. we need pilot customers for feedback.

Evan Park: eng-platform needs owners to provide staging capacity numbers. please confirm owners by EOD so we can reserve quota.

Priya Sharma: owners? Marco for API runtime, Alice for Console UX, Sofia for Optimize suggestions. Ben will handle customer comms. Evan + Dana for infra/SLO gating.

Marco Valdez: confirmed owner for API runtime: Marco Valdez. will deliver canary hooks and compatibility tests.

Ben Ortiz: confirmed comms owner: Ben Ortiz. i'll prepare a short slide with qualifiers ("target windows, dependent on infra & SLOs"), and hold publishing until we see a green on canary start.

Priya Sharma: Dana (SRE) requested that SLO pass/fail criteria and canary traffic profiles be finalized by 2024-05-03. if missed -> shift canary. can someone own that?

Marco Valdez: i'll own SLO draft with Dana. action: marco + dana to post SLO doc in #eng-sre by 2024-04-30.

Evan Park: platform action: i'll post staging capacity ask template by EOD. need per-region numbers and expected qps for canary.

Sofia Rivas: pilot ask: can marketing share a short list of customers willing to join Optimize pilot? Ben?

Ben Ortiz: yes, i'll ping top 10 pilot candidates and collect interest. won't promise billing changes during alpha.

Priya Sharma: schedule snippet to pin here:
```
API runtime v2: canary 2024-05-20 -> GA late May (TBD)
Console UX: flags in place 2024-06-04 -> beta 2024-06-11 -> GA ~2024-06-25
Optimize suggestions: alpha internal 2024-07-05 -> pilot 2024-07-12
```

Marco Valdez: I'll update roadmap doc with owners + a "blocking" column for quant infra and staging quota.

deploy-bot: scheduled task: reserve staging GPUs for api runtime canary on 2024-05-01 04:00 UTC :robot_face: 

Priya Sharma: perfect. please drop final owners + any deviating constraints in this thread by EOD so i can sync with the comms team.
